Question 1
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
df = pd.read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4names/master/data-raw/names_year/names_year.csv")
```

```{python}
# Include and execute your code here
Elliot_df = df[df["name"] == "John"]
breaks_range = list(range(1910,2030, 10))
(
  ggplot(Elliot_df, aes(x="year"))
  + geom_line(aes(y='UT'), color='red')
  + geom_line(aes(y='OR'), color='orange')
  + geom_vline(xintercept=1936, color='black', size=.5, linetype='solid')
  + geom_text(label="1936", x=1931, y=400, size=6, color="black")
  + geom_vline(xintercept=1976, color='black', size=.5, linetype='solid')
  + geom_text(label="1976", x=1971, y=700, size=6, color="black")
  + geom_vline(xintercept=1999, color='black', size=.5, linetype='solid')
  + geom_text(label="1999", x=1994, y=300, size=6, color="black")
  + labs(
    title="The history of John for Utah (red) and Oregon (orange)",
    y="Count of John",
    x="Year name given"
  )
  + theme(
    plot_title=element_text(size=11, hjust=-0.1, face="bold"),
    axis_title_x=element_text(size=11, face="bold"),
    axis_title_y=element_text(size=11, face="bold"),
    legend_position='none'
  )
  + scale_x_continuous(breaks=breaks_range, format='{}', limits=[1910, 2021], expand=[0])
  + scale_color_manual(values=["#6e78fa"], name="name")
)
```


Question 2
```{python}
problem = pd.DataFrame({"problem": ['N/A', 15, 22, 45, 31, -999, 21, 2, 0, 0, 0, 'broken', 19, 19, 36, 27, 0, np.nan, 0, 33, 42, -999]})

problem = problem.replace('N/A', np.nan)
problem = problem.replace(-999, np.nan)
problem = problem.replace('broken', np.nan)

problem.fillna(problem.mean(), inplace=True)

std = problem['problem'].std()
print(f"Standard Deviation: {std}")
```


Question 3
```{python}
flights = pd.read_json("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/raw/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json")
flights = flights.replace("1500+", "1500")
flights['num_of_delays_carrier'] = flights['num_of_delays_carrier'].astype(int)
flights = flights.replace(['','n/a', -999], np.nan)
flights = flights.replace('Febuary', 'February')
flights['month'] = flights['month'].ffill()
month_dict = {
    "January":1,
    "Febuary":2,
    "March":3,
    "April":4,
    "May":5,
    "June":6,
    "July":7,
    "August":8,
    "September":9,
    "October":10,
    "November":11,
    "December":12
}
flights['month'] = flights['month'].map(month_dict)
flights.month

(
    ggplot(flights, aes(x="month", y='num_of_flights_total'))
    + geom_bar()
)
```



Question 4
```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score

housing = pd.read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4dwellings/master/data-raw/dwellings_ml/dwellings_ml.csv")

features = ['livearea','basement','netprice','smonth','finbsmnt','numbdrm','tasp','deduct','abstrprd','nocars','gartype_Att','sprice','quality_C','status_I','quality_D','condition_AVG','arcstyle_ONE-STORY','arcstyle_MIDDLE UNIT','stories','syear','qualified_Q','gartype_Det','arcstyle_ONE AND HALF-STORY','arcstyle_END UNIT','arcstyle_TWO-STORY','condition_Good','quality_B','quality_A','totunits','condition_VGood','arcstyle_TRI-LEVEL','quality_X','gartype_det/CP','arcstyle_BI-LEVEL','arcstyle_THREE-STORY','condition_Excel','arcstyle_TRI-LEVEL WITH BASEMENT','arcstyle_CONVERSIONS','gartype_CP','arcstyle_TWO AND HALF-STORY','gartype_Att/Det','qualified_U','gartype_None','arcstyle_SPLIT LEVEL','condition_Fair','gartype_att/CP','status_V', 'before1980']

X = housing[features]
threshold = 2
y = np.where(housing['numbaths'] > threshold, 1, 0)

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=1776)

gbc = GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=1776)
gbc.fit(X_train, y_train)
gbc_pred = gbc.predict(X_test)

gbc_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, gbc_pred)
gbc_precision = precision_score(y_test, gbc_pred)
gbc_recall = recall_score(y_test, gbc_pred)
gbc_f1 = f1_score(y_test, gbc_pred)


print(gbc_accuracy)

influences = (pd.DataFrame({'importance': gbc.feature_importances_,
                           'feature': X_train.columns})
                           .sort_values('importance')
                           .query('importance >= 0.001')
                           )

(
ggplot(data = influences, mapping = aes(x = 'feature', y = 'importance'))
  + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') 
  + coord_flip()
  + labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Importance",
    title = "Decision Tree Classifier Feature Importance"
  )
  + theme(plot_title=element_text(size=15,hjust=-1.3))
)
```
